title: xcvrd crash on s6100 bootup - SFP index out of range
author: tjchadaga
body:

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
xcvrd crashes while getting SFP info due to SFP count mismatch and index out of range after changes in https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/9988
```
Feb 19 01:28:20.478904 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd SFP index 64 out of range (0-63)
Feb 19 01:28:20.484506 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd Traceback (most recent call last):
Feb 19 01:28:20.484578 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd   File "/usr/local/bin/xcvrd", line 8, in <module>
Feb 19 01:28:20.484626 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd     sys.exit(main())
Feb 19 01:28:20.484682 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 1434, in main
Feb 19 01:28:20.484753 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd     xcvrd.run()
Feb 19 01:28:20.484806 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 1391, in run
Feb 19 01:28:20.484860 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd     self.init()
Feb 19 01:28:20.484919 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 1361, in init
Feb 19 01:28:20.484976 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd     post_port_sfp_dom_info_to_db(is_warm_start, self.stop_event)
Feb 19 01:28:20.485138 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 518, in post_port_sfp_dom_info_to_db
Feb 19 01:28:20.485443 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd     post_port_sfp_info_to_db(logical_port_name, int_tbl[asic_index], transceiver_dict, stop_event)
Feb 19 01:28:20.485500 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 303, in post_port_sfp_info_to_db
Feb 19 01:28:20.485550 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd     if not _wrapper_get_presence(physical_port):
Feb 19 01:28:20.485597 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 151, in _wrapper_get_presence
Feb 19 01:28:20.485646 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd     return platform_chassis.get_sfp(physical_port).get_presence()
Feb 19 01:28:20.485693 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#/supervisord: xcvrd AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get_presence'
Feb 19 01:28:21.525224 str-s6100-acs-2 INFO pmon#supervisord 2022-02-19 01:28:21,524 INFO exited: xcvrd (exit status 1; not expected)
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Load image with https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/9988 
2. Check syslog and xcvrd status


#### Describe the results you received:
xcvrd crash with "SFP index 64 out of range (0-63)" error

#### Describe the results you expected:
No crash and xcvrd stays in RUNNING state

#### Output of `show platform summary`:

```
Platform: x86_64-dell_s6100_c2538-r0
HwSKU: Force10-S6100
ASIC: broadcom
ASIC Count: 1
```
#### Output of `show techsupport`:

```
(paste your output here or download and attach the file here )
```

     Also attach debug file produced by `sudo generate_dump`
-->
